title: Anyone reaching the pairing or rescue window could close it and flood the audit
description:
A node that trusts no fleet, or booted with a rescue volume, opens a short-lived window on :9506 with no client certificate. Wrong codes were counted globally, so five from anyone closed the window until the node restarted - a denial of service against provisioning or rescue from anyone who could reach the port. And a Rescue call on a pairing window was audited without counting a failure, so repeated calls filled the node's 2000-entry audit ring and evicted real entries.

**Affected**: a node with its pairing or rescue window open, reachable on :9506.

**Fix**: wrong codes are counted per source address; past five, that source is paused for a minute while the window stays open for everyone else, and a paused source's further calls are rate-limited (ResourceExhausted) and no longer audited; a Rescue on a pairing window is counted the same way.

**Besides updating**: nothing.
